title: Chapter 165: Naga Tribe Elder
content:
Chapter 165: Naga Tribe Elder

Three hundred thousand elite troops of the Bear Goblin tribe of the Evil God camp were ambushed by Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes during the battle. The Evil God priest team and the most powerful troops in the central army were all wiped out in the continuous self-explosion of 130 Explosive Mosquitoes.

The Evil God camp army, which lost the Evil God priest team, became a mess, fighting on its own, and was attacked by the 200,000 Zerg puppies and nearly 200,000 Naga troops who came to support.

The Naga army was brave and good at fighting. With the blessing of various luck secrets, its combat power has surpassed the Evil God camp army whose faith blessing was constantly disappearing. In addition, their morale is now high, and they have completely reversed the situation, from passive defense to fierce attack.

The Naga army entered a state of full-scale assault, suppressing the once invincible Evil God camp army.

The Zerg puppies relied on their own powerful combat power and the extremely tacit cooperation between each other to transform into a killing machine, killing the enemy with extremely high efficiency.

The bodies of the enemies killed by the Zerg will turn into light and disappear. They have no obstacles all the way and kill into the interior of the evil god camp army phalanx, cutting the evil god army into small phalanxes for encirclement and suppression.

The advantages of the Naga army and the Zerg army are becoming more and more obvious, but the evil god believers with firm beliefs will not retreat.

"For the glory of the spirit god!"

The evil god believers shouted slogans and continued to fight fearlessly. Even if they were severely injured, they would insist on fighting until their lives died.

However, the Naga army, who deal with the evil god believers every day, was not moved by such performance, and the killing became more fierce.

Needless to say, the Zerg puppies like this characteristic of the evil god believers the most. They will not run away no matter how they are beaten until they are killed, which greatly increases the efficiency of the Zerg killing.

After two hours of fierce fighting, the evil god camp army was completely destroyed, and the Naga army also suffered heavy losses. Only the Zerg puppies, after the first battle after two upgrades, performed almost perfectly and lost very few troops.

The battlefield was clearly divided into two camps. On one side, there were corpses everywhere and blood flowing like a river; on the other side, there was nothing left. Only various weapons and equipment and personal belongings were left on the ground. The blood followed its owner and disappeared into the light.

Not far from the battlefield, there were at least 200,000 logistics personnel from the evil god camp. They had not received any orders and could only stay where they were, fulfill their duties, and guard the combat supplies.

They watched the arrogant army of the bear goblins go to destruction step by step, and now it was finally their turn.

The Zerg puppies, who suffered the least losses, took the lead and rushed to the logistics personnel of the evil god camp.

These logistics personnel of the evil god camp were all strong and healthy evil god believers of various races. The local camp had no way to rescue them from the evil god. The only way was to kill them and free them.

Although the Zerg could transform them into parasites, this was not the Zerg's territory. It was better not to use this ability that could easily arouse his vigilance casually.

Since there was no other way, the Zerg had to do it and physically eliminate these evil god believers.

The Zerg could sacrifice on the battlefield, and killing these evil god believers would not benefit the evil god at all, and the Naga tribe was happy with it.

The Zerg was of course happy to pick up resources for free.

The elite evil god army was no match for the Zerg puppies. These evil god believers, who were no different from ordinary civilians, were in vain no matter how they resisted, and could not cause much damage to the Zerg puppies.

It was another one-sided massacre. Even the Naga tribe, who were used to killing, were shocked to see the Zerg puppies killing so efficiently.

The Naga army, which was temporarily resting on the battlefield, received news from Nagalong and those Naga warriors, and knew that these fierce battlefield butchers were Zerg troops coming to support the battle.

They were full of gratitude for this reinforcement that directly turned the tide of the battle and allowed the Naga tribe to turn defeat into victory.

Without this support army, they should all be lying on the battlefield now, sleeping here forever like their fallen comrades and the evil god believers they killed.

Although the final battle was fierce and the Naga army suffered heavy casualties, nearly 100,000 Naga soldiers survived.

It took the Zerg dogs a lot of time to finally eliminate the nearly 200,000 evil god believers who shouted the name of God until their death and hoped to return to the arms of the evil god.

The war officially ended. Wu Qing looked at the number of system resources and felt that the decision to send troops on this expedition was very wise!

At this point in the war, the number of Zerg puppies was still over 180,000. It can be said that the loss was negligible, but the resources brought were enough to build another multi-arms joint army of this scale.

With just this one battle, the Zerg has earned enough capital, and can play freely in the future. If there is a gain, it is pure profit. If necessary, Wu Qing will immediately prepare the second expeditionary army of the Zerg.

…

After the Zerg puppies cleaned up the remaining enemies, they withdrew from the battlefield and handed it over to the Naga tribe.

Small reinforcements from various Naga territories continued to arrive. When these reinforcements arrived, they saw that the battle had been won and were very happy.

Now that there was no need to fight, they went to clean up the battlefield, mainly to find the fallen comrades in their camp and gather the enemy's bodies to burn them. Otherwise, it would be a big trouble to guard the battlefield at night.

It is already afternoon now. Since the Zerg is the main force on the battlefield, most of the enemy's bodies have disappeared directly. The area to be cleaned up on this battlefield is not actually large. With more and more reinforcements coming, it should be cleaned up soon.

The Zerg army is resting and waiting on one side of the battlefield. With them by their side, the Naga army on the battlefield has a sense of security. The combat power of the Zerg army has left a very deep impression on them.

After waiting for a while, Nagalong, who had just returned from the battlefield and was busy again, came to find host No. 3.

"Leader No. 3, I don't need to thank you for your kindness! I won't say much about my gratitude!"

"The Zerg's kindness, I, the Naga tribe, will always remember it in my heart!"

Nagalong first expressed his gratitude.

"The main force of our tribe will arrive soon, led by our elders, who are the person in charge of our tribe in this area. All matters related to the nobles' assistance need to be reported to the elders!"

"We will wait here for the elders to arrive!"

Nagalong told host No. 3 that the highest person in charge of the Naga tribe in this area was in the main force that arrived, so he could just wait here and didn't need to find someone specifically.

"I look forward to meeting the noble elders!"

Wu Qing said through host No. 3.

The highest leader personally led the army to participate in the war, which shows that the situation facing the Naga tribe is quite bad.

However, with the participation of the Zerg, this situation will soon change, and today's war is a good proof.

If there is no Zerg to help, the army of the bear goblin tribe can completely wipe out all the Naga troops in the surrounding area.

The evil god army blessed and commanded by the evil god sacrificial group is very terrible. Various means emerge in an endless stream, and there will be a self-mutilation-style explosion at any time. Ordinary armies simply cannot withstand such an attack.

After the battle here, the army of the bear goblins will have another big battle with the main force of the Naga army. Since the bear goblins dare to come, they must have prepared certain means. If these means are used, the Naga army will suffer a lot of losses.

Perhaps these factors combined have become the last straw that overwhelmed the Naga tribe, leading to the complete defeat of the Naga tribe.

Fortunately, the Zerg explosive mosquito unexpectedly killed the sacrificial team of the evil god army, directly leaving the bear goblins no chance to use their means, otherwise, the casualties of the Zerg puppies would be very heavy.

...

About half an hour later, a Naga army came from the east. In front of the army, there were all well-equipped Naga warriors, who were elite troops on the battlefield who had experienced hundreds of battles.

A Naga female warrior wearing golden armor and even the scales of her snake body were pale gold rushed to the front of the army.

Through the perspective of Host No. 3, Wu Qing could see that the main force of the Naga tribe that came to help this time was almost all Naga warriors, with a strength of about 150,000.

The marching speed of this army was very fast, and it rushed to the front of the Zerg puppy resting place and stopped. On one side were Zerg puppies with more than 180,000 people, and on the other side were about 150,000 Naga warriors, facing each other.

On one side were iron armor, and on the other side were shiny shells!

The momentum of the two armies was very fierce and powerful.

Nagalong quickly swam in front of the two formations, came to the golden armored female warrior, and respectfully said: "Elder!"

"I don't know if the elder has received the information. These troops are Zerg reinforcements that have come from the Zerg territory to support our tribe in the battle!"

Nagalong had previously sent someone to pass on the news here.

"The message has been received, Nagalong, you did a good job!"

The Naga elder spoke, and his voice sounded very young.

Host No. 3 has already flown to the front of the formation.

Wu Qing saw the face of the Naga elder through host No. 3. It was very delicate, and he looked like a human in his twenties. However, there are many different races in this world, and the actual age cannot be seen from the face.

Her eyes were firm, and seeing her eyes, most people would ignore her appearance.

Wu Qing knew that the Naga tribe was a matriarchal race, and women were basically the head of the family. In addition to reproducing offspring, women were also warriors in the tribe. As long as women became warriors, their combat power was stronger than that of men.

"Elder, this is the full representative of the lord of the Zerg territory, Chief No. 3!"

"Chief No. 3, this is the elder of my tribe, Lord Naga!"

Naga Long formally introduced.

"Chief No. 3, it's nice to meet you!"

"Sincerely thank the nobles for coming to help!"

Naga solemnly expressed her gratitude to host No. 3.
